criteria.text: Optional top-level Sony config defaults to enabled, loopback API URL, and a state file beside DEVICES_CONFIG while existing configurations remain valid.
SONY_ENABLED, SONY_API_URL, SONY_SERVER_EXECUTABLE, and SONY_STATE_FILE override YAML; SONY_ENABLED accepts only true/false/1/0 and paths follow the specified resolution rules.
Approval state persists the version-1 safe-ID schema across a fresh store instance; approve updates metadata, forget removes it, and no credential fields are emitted.
Missing state returns empty and malformed, duplicate-ID state is quarantined without loading approvals.
Concurrent approvals serialize to valid persisted state, and a pre-rename failure preserves the old complete JSON file with best-effort 0600 output mode.
